findings.source_quote: “...and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth –Acts 1:8.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace ״וְהִתְקַיֵּם בִּי עֵדִים״ with ״וְתִהְיוּ עֵדִים לִי״ so the quotation says that the disciples will be witnesses to Jesus, as in the source.
findings.translation_quote: ״וְהִתְקַיֵּם בִּי עֵדִים בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם וּבְכָל יְהוּדָה וְשֹׁמְרוֹן וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ״

findings.location: Paragraph about Achan hiding the items
findings.source_quote: “He slipped them into his armor, then later hid them under his tent”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace ״החביא אותם בבגדיו״ with ״החביא אותם בשריונו״ to preserve the source’s detail that Achan put the items in his armor.
findings.translation_quote: ״הוא החביא אותם בבגדיו, ואחר כך הסתיר אותם מתחת לאוהלו״
